questions.question: Talk 1 (Girl talking about life since she left Vietnam) — Why did the speaker have to help her mother with the shopping?
answers: There were no Vietnamese people living near her.
There were no Vietnamese working in the stores.
There wasn't always someone to go shopping with her.
Her mother could speak a little English.

questions.question: Talk 1 — Why did her father find working in a factory difficult?
answers: He couldn't speak any English.
He didn't have many friends there.
He had had a much better job in Vietnam.
He couldn't get used to the working style.

questions.question: Talk 1 — Why are the speaker and her brother more fortunate than their sisters?
answers: They did not need extra English lessons.
They look more American.
They speak with American accents.
They quickly adopted the way of life.

questions.question: Talk 1 — What has the speaker forgotten about life in Vietnam?
answers: Living close to other people

Traditional food

questions.question: Talk 1 — Why does she find it difficult to invite friends to her home?
answers: Her parents do not have much money.

questions.question: Talk 2 (Boys and girls in American schools) — What happened in American schools before 1972?
answers: Girls didn't go to school.
Every classroom was a mix of boys and girls.
Boys could learn what they wanted.
They didn't teach girls some subjects.

questions.question: Talk 2 — What is the reason that most American schools have mixed classes?
answers: Scientists said that it was the best thing.
Teachers did not want to teach single-gender classes.
A law gave girls an equal chance to learn.
Boys and girls behave better in such classes.

questions.question: Talk 2 — Why might girls not get a chance to talk much in a class with boys?
answers: Because the teacher doesn't ask them questions
Because boys are louder and often talk first
Because boys know the correct answers
Because girls are often shy.

questions.question: Talk 2 — What is NOT the reason that some schools are reconsidering separating classes?
answers: They prefer the old teaching styles.
Boys learn differently than girls.
Boys and girls can bother each other.
Boys and girls like different things.

questions.question: Talk 2 — Which is one class that is not mentioned as being separated?
answers: Math
Social Studies
Science
Physical Education

questions.question: Talk 3 — According to the speaker, what is body language?
answers: It's the use of verb tenses and modals.

questions.question: Talk 3 — In American culture, ...
